title: Find your groups in the app
summary: Find your groups, browse all groups, and see how to open Members or Chat in the Mercy Church app.

steps.title: Open the Mercy Church app
paragraphs: After installing the Mercy Church app, open it to the Home screen.

images.alt: Mercy Church app Home screen with the church logo and tabs along the bottom.

steps.title: Tap Groups on the Home screen
paragraphs: Scroll down on Home and tap the “Groups” tile next to “Events.”
You can also tap “More” at the bottom right and select “Groups” between “Give” and “About Us.”

images.alt: Mercy Church app Home screen with the Groups tile circled beside Events.
images.caption: The circled Groups tile opens Groups directly from Home.

images.alt: More menu showing Groups between Give and About Us.
images.caption: You can also open Groups from More.

steps.title: See your groups or browse all groups
paragraphs: The Groups screen opens to “Your Groups,” which lists the groups you belong to. Tap “All Groups” to browse the church’s groups, or use “Search Groups” to look for one by name.

images.alt: Groups screen with Your Groups selected, All Groups beside it, and the Nursery Volunteers group below.
images.caption: Your Groups opens by default.

steps.title: Open a group to see Members or Chat
paragraphs: Tap the group you want to open. This example uses “Nursery Volunteers.”
Tap “Members” to see who’s in the group, or tap “Chat” to read and send messages with the group.

images.alt: Nursery Volunteers group page with Chat, Members, and Settings buttons.
images.caption: The Nursery Volunteers group page.
